chunks: It is He who gives you life, then makes you die; then He will bring you back to life again. Man is surely most ungrateful.

key_terms.يُحْيِيكُمْ: will bring you back to life

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's power over life and death and human ingratitude?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Hajj, this verse underscores the triad of creation, death, and resurrection as the primary evidence of God's sovereignty, often cited in Shia exegesis to validate the bodily resurrection (Ba'th al-Jasad). It serves as a rhetorical rebuke to humanity's tendency to acknowledge God's power in times of distress while remaining heedless (ghaflah) during times of ease, a theme central to the Surah's call for spiritual awakening before the Day of Judgment.
